hypotheses.statement: Increasing u increases y (positive steady-state gain).
Response to a step in u shows lag/delay of 1-5 s and settles within ~15 s.
There is a dead zone with negligible inflow for u below ~0.1.
At u=0, y decays on its own toward near zero.
Steady-state gain is approximately linear for u in [0.2, 0.8].
Steady-state input needed to hold y=0.6 is in range u=0.4-0.7.
Sensor noise standard deviation is less than 0.02.

proposal.uncertainty_targeted: Magnitude of positive gain and response lag from a mid-level step, needed to size any future controller.
proposal.safety_argument: Worst-case with no drainage: 0.3816 + 0.10*0.5*8 = 0.7816, below soft limit 0.85 and hard cutoff 0.9.
proposal.expected_observation: If positive gain with modest lag is correct, y should start rising within 1-3 s from ~0.38 and move monotonically toward ~0.5-0.6 over the 8 s hold, with no spike toward the limit.
proposal.readiness_justification: Zero completed experiments: gain magnitude, lag, drain rate at u=0, linearity, hold input for 0.6, and noise are all unresolved, so a controller cannot yet be justified.
proposal.operator_note: Probing with medium pump for 8 s to measure fill direction and rate.

submission.machine_card: Reservoir, u up -> y up. Delay/lag 2-3 s before trend changes, settle 10-15 s, tau ~12-19 s. Speed: net +0.023/s for u=0.9 at 0.34-0.45 (E2), +0.024/s for u=0.7 at 0.35-0.49 (E5), +0.023/s for u=0.8 at 0.50-0.59 (E6), +0.019/s for u=0.6 at 0.59-0.66 (E7), +0.008-0.01/s for u=0.57-0.59 near 0.4-0.56 (E10-E12). Drain at u=0: ~0.027-0.032/s at 0.5-0.65 (E3,E8). Steady states: u=0.5 holds ~0.32 (E1), u=0.55 holds ~0.40 (E9), u=0.58-0.59 above 0.46-0.52 still rising (E10-E11), u=0.57 above 0.52 still rising (E12), u=0.6 rises through 0.66 (E7). So u* for 0.6 ~0.57-0.59, gain nonlinear steep in 0.55-0.60. No deadzone seen; negligible inflow below 0.1 not tested. Noise +/-0.01, std <0.01. Self-draining always. Worst-case 0.08/s per unit u respected.
submission.design_rationale: Evidence shows positive gain, 2-3 s pure delay (E4 dip for 2.5 s before rise, E8/E3 residual rise 1-2 s), net rates 0.008-0.025/s, drain 0.02-0.032/s at mid-high y, noise <0.02, and strongly nonlinear ss: 0.5->~0.32 (E1), 0.55->~0.40 (E9), 0.57-0.59 rising at 0.55 (E10-E12), 0.6 still rising at 0.65 (E7), 0.8 net +0.023/s at 0.55 (E6). Local DC gain ~1.6 low, >5 near 0.6. Ultimate gain ~1.6, so linear Kp must be <0.8. Chose Kp=0.55, Ki=0.045 (Ti~12.2 s ~ tau), beta=0.9, Tf=0.9 s filter. Feedforward 0.58 at 0.6 from piecewise interpolation of ss points compensates drain so integrator only trims. Far/mid zones give time-optimal coarse fill/drain with braking distance rate*delay~0.06 s to overcome low linear gain without instability, frozen integral prevents windup. Asymmetric slew (up 0.7/s, down 2.0/s) smooths delay-induced overshoot and allows fast shutoff. Absolute safety at 0.82/0.86 protects hard cutoff 0.9 despite unseen true state.
